pad_directed_log_potentials: pad directed log potentials adjacency matrix preserving log-partition value for variable-length dependency trees
directed_tree_mask: build a directed tree mask for dependency parsing with variable-length node sequences
undirected_tree_mask: build an undirected tree mask excluding diagonal entries for variable-length node sequences
pad_directed_log_potentials_apply: apply padding mask to log potentials so padded arcs get weight 0 and invalid arcs get -INF
directed_tree_mask_filter: filter adjacency matrix entries to valid directed tree edges given node lengths
